hero.subtitle: The guide to investing in Mozambique
hero.lead: From your first contact with APIEX to the first day of operation. Read the guide chapter by chapter — the country, the sectors, the Investment Law, the company, tax, labour and exchange control — or describe your project and get a tailored assessment, always with the legal reference.

guide.title: Twelve chapters, from the country to protecting your investment
guide.text: Based on the APIEX Investment Guide 2026, Tax Advisory's tax sheets and company registration guide, and the Business Guide 2025. Every chapter ends with the next steps.

map.label: Map of Mozambique showing provinces, main cities, ports and corridors
map.hint: Hover over or tap a province

problem.title: Eight legal regimes before day one
problem.text: A foreign investor in Mozambique meets company law, licensing, investment, tax, employment, immigration, exchange control and customs — each with its own instrument and authority.

tax.title: Tax
tax.covers: IRPC, VAT, withholding and tax treaties

customs.title: Customs
customs.covers: Imports, Class K and temporary import

how.title: From the first map to the first day, in three steps

step1.title: Read the guide
step1.text: The country, the sectors and the path to operation: the Investment Law, company setup, tax, labour and exchange control.

step2.title: Describe your project and get the assessment
step2.text: Business, province, origin of capital, investment and staff. You get the company vehicle, a timed roadmap, licences, incentives and obligations, with the legal references.

step3.title: Talk to Tax Advisory
step3.text: Your enquiry reaches the firm with the project summary attached. A professional validates it and proposes next steps.

how.pricing: General information is free and instant. Detailed advice, drafting and filings are paid services of Tax Advisory.

trust.title: Built like an advisory memo, not a guess

reviewed.title: Answers only from a reviewed legal base
reviewed.text: Every answer cites the instrument it comes from. No source, no answer.

noInvented.title: No invented numbers
noInvented.text: When a value is not yet confirmed, it is flagged as "to be confirmed".

sources.title: Sources
sources.text: Tax Advisory's legal base, the APIEX Investment Guide 2026 and the Business Guide 2025 (Lex Africa).

language.title: Professional Portuguese (pre-AO90)
language.text: Written in Mozambican Portuguese with the spelling used in legal practice, and available in English and French.

partners.title: Tax Advisory × Law Technology Solutions
partners.ta: Tax and legal advisory firm in Maputo. Supplies and reviews all legal and tax content.
partners.lts: Builds the technology: the rules engine, the assistant and the platform.
partners.principle: The assistant provides the first map; a professional always validates detailed advice.
